tools.name: rulefoundry_get_extraction
tools.description: Read safe metadata for one accessible Extraction, including canonical completed co-admin access; unfinished sessions expose no transcript or business content.

tools.name: rulefoundry_search_extractions

tools.name: rulefoundry_list_artifacts

tools.name: rulefoundry_read_artifact

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "rulefoundry_create_extraction_request" is 2108 chars, far longer than this server's median (270). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "plugins" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rulefoundry_list_extractions, rulefoundry_get_extraction, rulefoundry_list_artifacts, rulefoundry_prepare_extraction_request, rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_open_library, rulefoundry_open_extraction_review · Private data: rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_ask_twin, rulefoundry_read_project_knowledge, rulefoundry_extract_from_recording · Public sink: rulefoundry_list_artifacts, rulefoundry_prepare_extraction_request, rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_update_extraction_request_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rulefoundry_list_extractions, rulefoundry_get_extraction, rulefoundry_list_artifacts, rulefoundry_prepare_extraction_request, rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_open_library, rulefoundry_open_extraction_review · Private data: rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_ask_twin, rulefoundry_read_project_knowledge, rulefoundry_extract_from_recording · Public sink: rulefoundry_list_artifacts, rulefoundry_prepare_extraction_request, rulefoundry_create_extraction_request, rulefoundry_update_extraction_request_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
